value.account: Root causes (two, found in sequence). (1) orchestrator/workflow_lisp/lowering/control_loops.py: at rich-loop targets (>=2.29) the lowering materialised a placeholder step for relpath leaves of inactive variants and emitted an on_exhausted override {ref: placeholder} for them; the validator only allows scalar overrides, hence 'may only override scalar repeat_until outputs'. Fix: _exhausted_inactive_placeholder_values now excludes relpath-kind leaves, so no placeholder step and no override is emitted; the frame keeps its last-iteration placeholder literal, as at 2.28. (2) Once it compiled, exhaustion failed at runtime: at >=2.29 the UNRESOLVED arm joins read loop output result__rounds (2.28 reads state__round), and the on_exhausted override {ref: root.steps.<loop>.artifacts.state__round} was stored as an unresolved ref dict, failing integer validation. Fix in orchestrator/workflow/loops.py repeat_until_exhaustion_artifacts: for workflow version >=2.29, overrides that are exact self-loop refs are replaced by the value from the exhaustion frame snapshot (state-as-of-last-iteration). Gated on version so 2.28 persisted state is unchanged. Tests: tests/test_workflow_lisp_loop_result_path_exhaustion.py runs bugs/loop_result_paths/reviewed_change.orc end to end (fake providers) at 2.28/2.29/2.32 for exhaustion and approval, plus malformed provider output (APPROVE without report) still failing the run. Verified: new tests fail before and pass after; loop/exhaustion/rich-loop modules pass; a wider sweep of 25 modules mentioning on_exhausted has the same 18 failures before and after my change (pre-existing, e.g. phase_stdlib, procedures). Considered and discarded: letting the validator accept generated refs for relpath outputs (first attempt) - it compiled but weakened the scalar-only rule's intent and the placeholder path was not needed; and resolving refs at read time in the executor join (broader blast radius). Not covered: other non-self refs in on_exhausted overrides are still not eagerly resolved at runtime; non-loop-state ref shapes and resume-after-exhaustion were not specifically tested; full suite not run per instructions; bugs/ untouched.
value.summary: Loop results with path fields in non-exhausted variants now compile and run at 2.29-2.32 exactly as at 2.28, via two small fixes in the loop lowering and the repeat_until runtime.

notes: La prueba integrada cubre 2.28, 2.29 y 2.32; 2.30 y 2.31 comparten la rama de versión, pero no se ejecutaron por separado.
No se probó una reanudación después del agotamiento ni se ejecutó la suite completa.
